parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, facility ban, border/document friction or current police targeting is documented; hate-crime provisions since 2017, police training and guidelines to address detainees by identified gender are traveler-relevant positives. Against this, culture is described as strongly heteronormative with persistent ostracism/harassment, and police are reported to disregard hate-crime complaints with attacks often unpunished - thin recourse if outed. The 2009 kidnapping/sexual assault of three trans women and 2014 assault are severe but dated, with no later incident recorded and no current trans-specific rate; the 2012/2019 surveys are LGBT-wide and dated, so not current prevalence. This is tier-3 hostility with weak remedy, without a tier-1 universal exposure.
